definition: a performer who tells jokes for a living
description: In a small basement comedy club with pipes on the ceiling, fairy lights and a single spotlight, a young man in a brown corduroy jacket and jeans stands on a low black stage next to a microphone stand with a calm, straight face. In front of him the audience roars with laughter: people bend over in their seats, one man lies on the floor, a chair tips over and falls, and spilled beer lies on the wooden boards. The view moves closer to the man, who stays serious.

taps.phrase: to stand next to a microphone
